why: Deletes the gate itself (issue #983): `versusMapChoices` stops applying the unlock, so every place that reads the offer through it -- the Map row, the retained-selection check, the stored-setup check and Random's draw -- offers a campaign board whose level was never cleared. The declaration filter above it is untouched, so every ungated test (the parity pin, the cross-check, the floor) reads identically; only an assertion made at a fresh or partial save can see it.
